Name: Pearlicious Fish
Author: LucyTheOrange
Description:
[b]🐠 Dive Into New Waters[/b]

Bring many cute fishies to Stardew Valley with over 18 new fish! Pearlicious Fish (PF) is a mod designed to add vanilla-friendly fish to all of Stardew Valley's waters, this mod expands your fishing adventures without breaking game progression. This mod is a collaboration between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LucyTheOrange]LucyTheOrange[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PronomicalArtist]Calart[/url] (PronomicalArtist).

[b]Enjoying this mod?[/b] Consider [b]endorsing[/b], it goes a long way and helps the mod grow! 💝


[b]🌊  Features:[/b]

🐟 18+ new fish in rivers, ponds, caves, and mountain lakes
📜 10+ new and unique quests from all NPCs
⚖️ Balanced for difficulty, sell price, and spawn rates
🔍 Works perfectly with vanilla fishing mechanics
📝 Compatible with all existing fishing levels, professions, and mods
🧭 Designed for exploration and discovery, no early game imbalance


[b]🐬 Installation:[/b]

This mod is ready to go right out of the box, while also compatible with any existing save of Stardew Valley 1.6+
No new save needed, simply drag and drop it into your Mods folder.

Steps:
[left]
[list]
[*]Download and extract the mod’s .zip file[/*]
[*]Place the folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed (required for mods)[/*]
[*]Launch the game and cast your line[/*]
[/list]

[b]🌎 Translations:[/b]

If you’d like to contribute a translation, or correct an existing one, then message me on Nexus before you publish it. Starting now, all translations will be handled by the respected translators, on their own mod translation page. 💙

[u][b]AI is strictly prohibited[/b][/u]. Code, sprites, and similar generated by these models are not ever accepted[i]. This policy is in place indefinitely and is not subject to change. [/i]🔒

[b]
❓ Q&A[/b]

[b]Q:[/b] What if I’m already in Year 3+?
[b]A:[/b] All quests and letters will be safe.

[b]Q:[/b] Does this support Stardew Aquarium?
[b]A:[/b] Not yet! Integration depends on the Aquarium mod’s authors, but it may happen in the future.

[b]Q:[/b] How can I do a specific quest?
[b]A:[/b] Scroll down to the bottom of the page to see how it can be activated!

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any universally loved gifts?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! The Black Tahitian, Peacock Tahitian, and Melo Pearl! All sell for handsome amounts as well.
